name: Special Meeting Memo Revised
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: May 18, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Special City Council Meeting
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, at 9:00am at the City Administration Building, on the 12 th floor of 202 “C” Street, for the following:
Consent agenda:
Senate Bill 79 Phased Implementation and Exempting Specified Areas.
Discussion agenda:
TransNet Local Street and Roads Program - 2027 Regional Transportation Improvement Program (RTIP) Development and Fiscal Years 2027 – 2031 Program of Projects.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at (619) 235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at (619) 533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
